{"kind":"final","text":"Done. The fault was that all three animateTransform elements had begin="indefinite", so they never started automatically and the verifier reported pelican_animation_not_started with no active animations.

What I did:
1. Read pelican.svg (sha256 2cb6272b…) and ran pelican.verify, which confirmed the failure: activeAnimations was empty while back-spin, front-spin, pedal-spin were expected, geometry preserved.
2. Previewed and applied one minimal exact-text patch against that observed sha256, deleting only begin="indefinite" from the three animateTransform elements so they use the SVG default begin of 0s.
3. Ran pelican.verify after the write. Latest real result: passed=true, currentSha256 60459cf2…, activeAnimations and expectedAnimations both [back-spin, front-spin, pedal-spin], geometryPreserved=true, all three groups (wheel-back, wheel-front, pedal) changed=true, no errors or warnings.

Preservation confirmed: only the begin attribute was removed from the three existing animations. The element tree, ids, dur (1.6s), from/to rotation values and rotation centers (250 400, 550 400, 398 400), all other attributes, and every geometric element are unchanged; no nodes, CSS, JS, or metadata were added."}
